verdict.rationale: ROS 2 records and persists data (rosbags, transient-local QoS durability), so asking whether a user can control retention and deletion is a fair question. The evidence documents no retention policies, expiry, or deletion controls for recorded or persisted data. QoS durability and bag recording are adjacent persistence features, not privacy-oriented retention or deletion controls, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
